description: Project Scaffolder: a phase-gated, multi-agent development flow for Claude Code.

plugins.name: project-scaffolder
plugins.description: Five sequential phases with hard gates (brainstorm, foundation, design, build, release), eight specialist agents with fixed models, a second-brain wiki, a secrets folder that never leaves the machine, design-system-first artboards with anti-slop and accessibility critique, a bug hunt after every task, and release, improvement and research loops.
